prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck strain after a low-speed head-on collision. The patient had 22 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1188; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment ran somewhat longer than usual for this injury.
- Nearly all findings rest on the patient's own pain reports; imaging and exam tests are normal.
- Years ago the patient had a small strain in the same area that healed fully.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a low-speed head-on collision with complaints of neck pain, stiffness, and intermittent headache. The mechanism of injury is consistent with the reported symptoms, and the presentation is in keeping with a cervical strain. Care was delivered over 22 visits, which is somewhat longer than typical for this injury, and progress was gradual with ongoing reports of discomfort. Physical examination findings were limited, and the primary basis for the clinical picture is the patient's own description of pain and its effect on daily activity. Cervical imaging was reviewed and showed no acute abnormality, and provocative orthopedic tests were negative. The patient reports a remote, minor strain to the same region in the past that resolved completely without lasting limitation. Billing records were reviewed and reflect single entries for each service without duplicate charges. Ongoing management includes home stretching, activity modification, and as-needed analgesia, with reassessment planned to determine whether further visits are warranted.
